posts.text: F1 has agreed a ten-year deal for an African Grand Prix in Rwanda from the early 2030s. A new circuit is planned in Bugesera, south of Kigali. The first race date is still to be announced. https://www.formula1.com/en/latest/article/everything-we-know-about-f1s-all-new-race-in-rwanda.3Mde3s9FqIOTbkzKs0Puwo
